commit_and_freeze_time: Resolve the annotated tag: git rev-parse phase1-timing-only^{commit}; git for-each-ref --format="%(taggerdate:iso-strict)" refs/tags/phase1-timing-only
scope: Preserves acquired timing-only inferences and their recorded limitations; does not certify every experimental requirement as satisfied. No Phase-II measurements have been acquired.
raw_hash_source: Previously verified immutable archive manifests; this handoff checks their presence and sizes without repeating the multi-gigabyte hash pass.
raw_restore: Restore revised then uncertainty as an ordered overlay. Restore independent-load separately, as described in README.md.
known_limitations: Inclusion: lower-only eviction uncalibrated; tests preceded later cache refinements and were not repeated afterward.
Physical L2/LLC hit times and isolated first-access miss penalties are not established.
LLC ways, exact sharing and inclusion remain unresolved; other reported geometry remains conditional.
Software classifier has material threshold sensitivity; PMU hit-rate accuracy has not been measured.
Architecture/year citations and contributor details are deferred.
phase2_instruction: Keep these timing-only values unchanged. Collect hardware verification in a separate branch/workspace and report Timing Inference, PMU Evidence, Published/System Value, Source/Page and Error/Agreement separately.
